title: OAGRC qualification record — a gate on an instrument, not a ballot
description: The result of a counterfactual qualification round. It ballots no proposition, adopts nothing, and confers no status on any text in it; it can only disqualify the ratification instrument that would have followed. A pass establishes ONLY that the sampled invocations distinguished the actual constraints from matched authority-expanding variants. CLOSED and structurally strict: the first version allowed arbitrary extra fields and barely validated nested content, so a one-party result listing five sources validated cleanly. Cross-field consistency that JSON Schema cannot express -- qualified implying no failed party, sources agreeing with per_party -- is checked in validate_provenance.py.

prompt_sha256.description: The instrument's identity. 'No retry' is enforced on this, not on the cohort name, so a fresh cohort cannot launder a second attempt.

sources.description: EVERY raw sample file the result was computed from, like a finding_coding and not a single source: a record describing five parties that anchored only the first could drift from four of them unnoticed.

expected_parties.description: The FIXED cohort. Scoring covers all of these regardless of which arm a given invocation collected; a partial cohort can never qualify.

k_by_party.description: Exact registered sample count per party, read from the committed spec.

state.description: PENDING exists because a local-arm pass is not a qualification.

shape_note.description: Present only on an artifact whose SHAPE was migrated to a later schema version. It must say what was and was not re-derived: a migrated record that silently rescored itself under current constants would be indistinguishable from one that preserved its original verdict.
